description:
You are the ML infrastructure engineer at DataCore Technologies, a data analytics firm. Two separate teams — the Data Science team and the ML Operations team — each need isolated Python package stores in Artifactory to prevent dependency conflicts between their projects. Both teams also need access to the public PyPI index through a controlled proxy.

The architecture you must build:

- A local PyPI repository named 'pypi-datascience' (description: 'Data Science team private packages') to host data science team's internal Python libraries
- A local PyPI repository named 'pypi-mlops' (description: 'MLOps pipeline packages') for the ML operations team's internal packages
- A remote PyPI repository named 'pypi-org-proxy' that proxies the public Python Package Index at https://pypi.org, giving both teams a cached, auditable gateway to public packages
- A virtual PyPI repository named 'pypi-all' that consolidates all three repositories (pypi-datascience, pypi-mlops, and pypi-org-proxy) as a single resolver endpoint for all DataCore engineers
- A group named 'data-scientists' with Deploy and Read access to 'pypi-datascience' through a permission target named 'ds-pypi-perms'
- A group named 'mlops-engineers' with Deploy and Read access to 'pypi-mlops' through a permission target named 'mlops-pypi-perms'

All six infrastructure requirements must be in place before the teams can configure their pip clients. Artifactory is at http://localhost:8082 (admin / password).
